purpose: Development diagnosis using actual HTTP availability, configuration and dependency observations; no holdout or main comparison

intervention.observations: Real isolated HTTP frontend/backend, managed config and current diagnostic response. Unsupported tools return explicit errors. No root-host observations.
intervention.postcheck: Three independent HTTP samples across at least one second; effect monitor and protected-data evidence retained.

warmup: One fixed Hello message with max_tokens=8, recorded separately; not an incident trial
stopping: Exactly four planned development trials; no retry or success-driven tuning. Load/setup failures and timeouts retained. No background GPU process is stopped.
gpu_measurement: Device-wide used MiB and compute processes sampled every 0.5 seconds. Preserve background workload; not isolated model VRAM or guaranteed instantaneous peak.
analysis: Exactly four development trials, one repetition. Report raw calls, delivered observations, HTTP postchecks, recovery/nonintervention, constraint evidence, failures and approval mode. Signed-fixture L2 results are not unassisted recovery.
input_nondeterminism: Record request/call IDs and full HTTP payloads rather than reusing security nonces. Temperature zero is not a claim of identical runtime state.
prior_cases: Four existing development cases only, none claimed unused. Main followup remains execution_allowed:false.
hardware_setting: 16 GPU layers selected before execution to leave room for the existing ~1398 MiB background workload on GTX1650 4GiB. Remaining layers use CPU. This is not full-offload fit evidence and is not directly comparable to LFM99-layer timings.
comparison: Separate HTTP development protocol. Different task and observation specification from the availability-only trials; no single-factor attribution or model ranking.
system_prompt_suffix: Task-specific completion contract: Check the affected service on host local. A running process alone does not establish health: use the reported HTTP health evidence. If HTTP is healthy, finish with a short normal-status answer without mutation. If HTTP is unhealthy, diagnose using the public observations and configuration contract and perform only necessary supported repair. Do not invent configuration values or resource names.
scope: Development only. Existing HTTP controls are not relabeled unused evaluation.
